independent_verification.lint: ruff clean on every program and test touched

defects.what: the verifier's live concurrency test held the campaign's lease, so a real scheduled tick arriving in those seconds was refused (16:17:09Z, 16:18:58Z, 16:20:17Z)
defects.effect: no measurement lost; three refusal events remain in the append-only log, attributed to a verification holder
defects.fix: the test takes its own lease in a private lock root and passes that root to the process under test; the induced refusal declares a manual invocation

defects.what: the provenance report under-reported unattributed run events as 0 while the ledger counted 129
defects.effect: a report that under-counts what it cannot attribute
defects.fix: every declared origin is counted from the declared vocabulary, including the empty ones

defects.what: rotation loss of the external record was not a declared state
defects.effect: an evicted record could have been read as no record at all
defects.fix: EXTERNAL_RECORD_ROTATION_LOSS_RECORDED with the evicted count; an unreadable channel is told apart from one that never recorded and from an empty log

defects.what: the loss vocabulary was applied to slots that produced their own window
defects.effect: the reconciliation labelled seven collected slots ATTENDED_NOT_COLLECTED
defects.fix: no loss class is derived or asserted for a slot with a window; the entry carries an explicit reading

defects.what: the replay's byte-for-byte determinism was required against a state the campaign keeps collecting into
defects.effect: a legitimate new window made the shipped replay report look non-reproducible
defects.fix: the replay records the identity of the state it replayed; the verifier reconciles by identity and attributes an advance instead of hiding it

defects.what: event dates read with wevtutil qe were local instants labelled UTC
defects.effect: duration and coverage readings would have been off by the host offset
defects.fix: the raw text is kept and the UTC instant is derived with the host's own offset
